results.title: Near 18,500 youths from 8 districts apply to become entrepreneurs
results.description: Under the first phase of Bangladesh Bank’s "Udyog" program—aimed at discovering young entrepreneurs at the upazila (sub-district) level and generating employment through financing—a total of 18,444 applications have been submitted across eight districts. results.title: ANALYSIS-IMF/World Bank meetings leave developing countries with more questions than answers
results.description: Last weeks meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank yielded no new answers for the developing world to the questions posed by a spreading Middle East war continuing war in Ukraine rising debt payments and a potential AI bubble

results.title: Holiday Inn Dhaka City Centre hosts Bengali food festival
results.description: Holiday Inn Dhaka City Centre is hosting its Bengali food festival, “Shorote Rosonabilash”, for a second time, offering traditional dishes such as mustard fish curry, prawn malai curry and kosha mangsho.
